_comment: Organisation-owned entities that are not personal data: store and product names from the retailer's master data. The Bronze->Silver job never redacts a detected NAME that lies inside one of these in the same text (live, PR-07 demo smoke: Bedrock Guardrails flagged 高雄前鎮店 and Taichung Xitun as names). Maintained as reference data; tests/test_lakehouse_transform.py requires the generator's stores and products to be listed here.
